row.title: REGEN-PARITY-1: every pure generator runs at pull-request time, because a pull request carries no generated file
row.body: PR-NO-GENERATED-1 stopped pull requests carrying generated files. The PR-time list (scripts/regen_generated.sh) lacked six pure generators that the post-merge list runs: ultrastability data, admit, owndb, tenantcontrols, upstream contract, plugins self. A pull request that changed one of their sources failed its freshness check and had no way to pass: #2615 added an essential variable and failed on site/ultrastability-data.js. Now the six run at PR time, the eight generators that record an event or read the network are named in POST_MERGE_ONLY with a reason each, and a test fails any generator that is in neither place. Two lists of the same thing need a test that compares them.
